Name: Better Artisan Good Icons for Magical Crops
Author: Fate0of0man
Description:
I whipped up some icons for the jellies, juice, wine, and pickles that you can make with the fruit and veggies in Magical Crops, and I thought I'd share

Just drop it in your mods folder and it should work, as long as you have Better Artisan Good Icons (and its dependencies)
